skill.summary: Detect text originality and AI-generated content.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the plagiarism-checker skill.
- Detects text originality and identifies AI-generated content.
- Provides structured reports with originality scores, AI generation probability, and paragraph-level analysis.
- Accepts input via direct text or file uploads (.txt, .md, .docx).
- Includes recommendation and rewriting suggestions for low-scoring content.
